card.name: Speech verbs before a named scientist
card.fires_on: Attribution words like said, says, scientist or professor that come right before the name of a researcher quoted in a climate or environment news story.

modes.label: Said after a quote
modes.description: The verb said or says follows a closing quotation and leads into an expert's name and affiliation.

modes.label: Title before a name
modes.description: A job title such as scientist or professor sits just before the expert's name.
modes.example: According to University of Minnesota<< scientist>> Peter Reich, also contacted through CSRRT
